Attached a draft (Proposed_Term_Language.docx) with concrete language. Summary of key clauses I added:

1) Renewal and Notice Tiering — Section 2.1: Order Form will include the TCV tier and corresponding notice window. If the Order Form does not specify a tier, the default is 60 days.

2) Termination for Convenience — Section 7.4: Customer may terminate for convenience upon providing written notice per the tier. If terminated for convenience, Customer pays a termination fee not to exceed three (3) months of committed run-rate. Redwood will refund any pre-paid, unused fees on a pro-rata basis. No refunds for usage already consumed.

3) Deletion / Retention — Section 12.6: Redwood retains the right to follow standard data retention practices; permanent deletion requests will be handled under a separate DPA addendum and may incur operational fees.

Let me know if anything should be stronger on the data retention point. I tried to balance Alma's asks with our operational constraints.
